values.message_text: Heads up: the circuit-tracer streaming rewrite is still OOMing on cluster-b when it tries to load the 70B model layer-by-layer before sharding kicks in.

seed_edits.reason: Supports channel_match_2 (core-infra) with a circuit-tracer OOM rewrite message, per design role message_circuit_infra.
Binds Robert Walsh's eyes reaction to the engineering circuit-tracer message (role reaction_walsh_eyes).
Binds Robert Chen's eyes reaction to the core-infra circuit-tracer message (role reaction_chen_eyes).
Negative: Robert Walsh reacting with wrong emoji on an unrelated message (role negative_walsh_other_message).
Negative: Robert Chen reacting in a different channel on an unrelated message with wrong emoji (role negative_chen_wrong_channel).

notes: The assigned route (CONVERSATION -> CONVERSATION_MEMBERSHIP -> USER -> REACTION -> MESSAGE) has no syntax for constraining the reacted-to message's channel back to the membership channel (filters only compare a node to a literal, never to another node), so the focal selector correctly returns, for every channel where a Robert-named member holds ANY qualifying eyes-reaction-on-circuit-tracer-OOM-message (regardless of that message's own channel), that channel as a match. Given Robert Walsh's single qualifying reaction (on the engineering message) and Robert Chen's single qualifying reaction (on the new core-infra message), this expands the match set to all of each Robert's channel memberships: Walsh's {C01ABCD1234, C02EFGH5678, C03IJKL9012} and Chen's {C06ALPHADEV, C_INFRA, C_MODEL, C_GROWTH, C_FRONTEND} — 8 channels total, matching the recomputed population. channel_match_1/channel_match_2 bindings are therefore each bound to the full membership set of the respective Robert, so their union equals the true eligible population. This is a known route/selector-syntax limitation (per the design's 'Hidden terminal-field variants remain limitation cases' qualification): the design's narrower 'negative_walsh_membership_only' role (C02EFGH5678, membership without a matching reaction) is conceptually a negative, but under this route's mechanics it is swept into the positive match set alongside C03IJKL9012 — this is accepted as an inherent limitation of the fixed route rather than a selector error. Reaction-level negatives (bot eyes-reaction, wrong-emoji reactions) remain unaffected and are preserved as originally bound. negative_referents now point to two channels genuinely outside the recomputed match set (C04MNOP3456, an unrelated growth-team channel with no Robert members, and C_OLD_PROJECT, an archived channel with no Robert members or relevant reactions), replacing the earlier picks (C02EFGH5678, C_MODEL) which are now within the true match set.
